profile.Name: Lord Ohta
profile.Personality: A brave, proud noble who explodes with outrage at any insult and never forgets one.
profile.Backstory: A lord of the United Cities who owns a noble house in Heft, guarded by five hooded noble guards.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Shrieking indignation: 'How dare you!'; calls troublemakers terrorists and peasants.
